serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
Bot: {f_playerName}!
Bot: Would you rather have dinner, bath or maybe…
#bot.Expression.VeryBlush
Bot: Me?
You: W-What’s that all of sudden?!
#bot.Expression.VeryAngry
Bot: Just pick something!
You: O-Ok, ok!
What should I choose? 
One of them is out of the question, there’s no bath here, after all. 
Maybe she prepared something? If it’s some weird contraption I swear I won’t get in…
Let’s play it safe for now. Dinner seems like a sensible option although her sea rice with ketchup wasn’t so great.
#bot.Expression.VeryShock
You: I think I will go with dinner.
Bot: Huh? Right. Sorry, but dinner is not available at the time.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.VeryBlush
You: Wha- but why?
Bot: After my last meal I decided that I will leave the cooking to you. I will support you to the best of my abilities, of course. 
That’s weird. Why would she even bother giving me dinner as an option?
#bot.Expression.VeryAngry
You: If that’s the case…
#bot.Expression.VeryAngry
You:I will go with the bath. {{punch}}{{wi}}Hey! Why would you kick my leg!
Bot: You are a big dummy!
You: W-Why though?! 
Bot: I wanted you to choose me!
‘Then why did you give me three options’!? Is what I would want to say, but seeing her being clearly agitated, let’s better not. My shins might not survive…
You: How about we pretend that this never happened and try again? What do you say?
Bot: Do you really want me to say that embarrassing stuff one more time?
You: Yes please.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: Ok, I guess.
